> If you go looking for something specific, your chances of finding it are
> very bad. Because of all the things in the universe, you're only looking for
> one of them. If you go looking for anything at all, your chances of finding
> it are very good. Because of all the things in the world, you're bound to
> find some of them.
>
> — Daryl Zero, *Zero Effect*

## Source

*Zero Effect* (1998), written and directed by Jake Kasdan. Bill Pullman plays
Daryl Zero, a private detective modelled loosely on Sherlock Holmes, and the
line is one of the principles of investigation Zero recites through the film.
Transcriptions differ slightly: some open with "When you go looking" and some
end "sure to find some of them".
